CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  December 22, 2020, 2020 - 3:30 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber

  SPECIAL MEETING
  The virtual meeting was convened pursuant to Executive Order N-29-20 issued by
  Governor Gavin Newsom on March 17, 2020, and was held solely by
  videoconference/teleconference

OPENING:  Mayor Gordo called the special meeting to order at 3:38 p.m.
  (Absent: None)

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Victor M. Gordo
 Councilmembers:  Vice Mayor Andy Wilson
  Councilmember Tyron Hampton
  Councilmember John J. Kennedy
  Councilmember Steve Madison
  Councilmember Gene Masuda
  Councilmember Felicia Williams

  Staff:  City Manager Steve Mermell
  City Attorney/City Prosecutor Michele Beal Bagneris
  City Clerk Mark Jomsky

  Mark Jomsky, City Clerk, reported that one letter from Wayne Hunt,
  Pasadena resident, was received requesting that the City prohibit
  use of the "Rose Bowl" or "Rose Bowl Game" outside of the Rose
  Bowl Stadium and Pasadena, which was distributed to the City
  Council, posted on-line, and made part of the public record.

  City Clerk Jomsky also read aloud comments from the following
  individuals opposing the use of "Rose Bowl" or "Rose Bowl Game"
  to be used outside of the Rose Bowl Stadium and Pasadena:

  Wayne Hunt, Pasadena resident
  Elias Marin a pseudonym
  Paul Little, representing Pasadena Chamber of Commerce

  In addition, he read aloud comments from Rich Chinen, Pasadena
  resident, in support of the City allowing the use of "Rose Bowl" or
  "Rose Bowl Game" to be used at the College Football Playoff in
  Texas.

  On the order of the Mayor, the special meeting recessed at 3:46
  p.m., to discuss the following closed session:

  CITY COUNCIL CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY
  NEGOTIATORS Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54956.8
  Property: 1001 Rose Bowl Drive, Pasadena, CA
  Agency negotiator: Steve Mermell

Council Minutes  12/22/2020
   Negotiating parties: David Eads
  Under negotiation: Price and terms of payment

  CITY COUNCIL CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL -
  ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Significant exposure to litigation pursuant to Government
  Code Section 54956.9(d)(2) (one potential case)

  CITY COUNCIL CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL -
  CONSIDERATION OF INITIATION OF LITIGATION pursuant to
  Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4) (one potential case)

  The above closed session items were discussed, with no
  reportable action at this time.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special meeting of the City Council
  adjourned at 6:44 p.m.

  Victor M. Gordo, Mayo
  City of Pasadena
